# Villa Mima

> Villa Mima is a restored 150-year-old stone holiday villa in Muo, on the quiet
> western shore of the Bay of Kotor, Montenegro. It sleeps 8 guests in 4 bedrooms
> (3 bathrooms), with a private pool, a separate annex, 10,000 m² of private
> gardens and hillside, and panoramic views over the entire bay. It is a family
> home, named after the owners' mother; their father was born in the house. Guests
> book direct with the family for the best rate, with no platform fees.

## Key facts

- Location: Muo, Bay of Kotor, Montenegro — 20 minutes' walk (4 minutes' drive)
  from Kotor's UNESCO World Heritage old town; ~20 minutes from Tivat airport (TIV)
- Sleeps: 8 · Bedrooms: 4 · Bathrooms: 3 · Separate annex with its own entrance
- Private pool; 10,000 m² of private land with a nature trail up the mountainside
- Original 150-year-old stone walls and wooden beams, fully restored luxury interiors;
  naturally cool in summer, warm in winter
- On-the-ground hosts: the owners' cousins, Lidija and Miro
- Availability is synced live across all booking channels; direct booking
  (best rate, no platform fees) via the website's enquiry form

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.villamima.com/): the story of the house and family
- [The Villa](https://www.villamima.com/villa): rooms, annex, pool, amenities, gallery
- [Explore](https://www.villamima.com/explore): the family's local guide — the Kotor
  cable car to Mount Lovćen, the city walls, Perast, restaurants, day trips
- [Availability & Booking](https://www.villamima.com/availability): live calendar,
  direct enquiry form, booking FAQ
- [Contact & Getting Here](https://www.villamima.com/contact): airports, driving
  routes from Dubrovnik/Tivat/Podgorica, practical information

## Booking

To book or check dates, use https://www.villamima.com/availability — the calendar
shows live availability and the enquiry form reaches the family directly (reply
usually within one day; no payment is taken online).
